notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 - New challenges now available on PlayStation 5!
notes.content:
Hello Shipbreakers! 🤝

New Challenges for PlayStation 5 owners! 🔵

Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 on PlayStation 5 have an exciting new challenge ahead with the arrival of two fantastic DLCs: Steel Giants DLC and the Submarines DLC. 🔥

🔸 Submarines DLC - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

[previewyoutube=ddUp3ERrhok;full][/previewyoutube]
These DLCs have been released for console owners to enrich the console experience and offer fresh and engaging content that will test your shipbreaking skills like never before on console! 🎮

🔸Steel Giants DLC on PlayStation 5
Steel Giants DLC introduces a new range of massive, heavily-armored ships for you to dismantle. These colossal vessels will push your limits as you work through layers of tough steel plating and complex structures. Every part of these giants presents new opportunities for strategic dismantling and salvage, making this DLC a thrilling challenge on the PlayStation 5 console.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2STEEL0002

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/24decd802537049a8d684c6323cdad14d5cc71b3.jpg

Submarines DLC takes you deep below the waves to explore and break down underwater vessels. This DLC features a variety of submarines with unique designs and components that require a different dismantling approach.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP5805-PPSA22000_00-ULGSGS2SUBMA0001

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/3c5ca5eb115ce75d9b02dc9e867f5f595a9dae7d.jpg

Together, these two DLCs bring significant new content and challenges to the PlayStation 5 version of Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. Whether you're conquering the towering Steel Giants or delving into the mysteries of the Submarines, these DLCs promise extra hours in the PlayStation 5! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/c7358393778c5561461219e14c6db5bc9647f447.png

Have fun!
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

 The server has been limited to 3 players
 Available ships are Maroon Lagoon (connector HP has been reduced) and Caroline

- Hazard
- Crouching
- Crane upgrades
- Mobile cargo along with input for walkie talkies
- Collectibles 
- Load option
- Continue option
- Credits

Warning:

⚓ Dear Players,

It's been over a year since the premiere of the first part of the game, thank you for being with us and creating an amazing community around the game. You provided us with many valuable notes, ideas, and suggestions, for which the entire team would like to thank you very much.

Today we are very pleased to announce that we are working on Ship Graveyard Simulator 2! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/9e06101a3a9df2977c17fee7af4fda07610a16d1.png

We are so happy that finally, we can shed some light on a title that is really something amazing for us, we were waiting so long to show you that. Even though the trailer is a very early, pre-alpha version of the game, it is definitely something to get excited about, and make sure to share your opinion with us!

Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 means not only a new game but also a new dev team!
A few words from new dev them:
"Hello Players,

We are a completely new team that will create Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 for you. We have been looking at your ideas and suggestions for several months, which you write on Community Hub and Discord, and it is an amazing database for us as the developers of the second part of the game. We have always known that listening to the community is a step in the right direction. You players showed us not only an amazing passion for the game but also provided new ideas, and suggestions - thank you for that!

We also know the problems you encountered in the first part of the game and we will try to eliminate them all. We assure you that the game will feature a full disassembly of ships, large ships - we mean really colossal ships - and there will be some interesting new gameplay features, but also well-known mechanics from the first game that have been significantly improved - so, it doesn't matter if you're a veteran in the game or for the first time you will have a hammer in your hands, you will get into this business.

The dev team from the first part will of course support us with their knowledge and skills. We hope that we will meet your expectations for the second part of the game, be sure to write to us on the Community Hub and on the new Discord channel, we are waiting for you.

So, let's start a new amazing adventure together, it's time to get back to the business."

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES
notes.content:
Hello Fans! 🛳️

It's been almost two weeks since the premiere of Ship Graveyard Simulator, and we thank you very much for your commitment and Steam reviews as well as participating in the discussion on discord and the Steam community hub. From the very beginning of production, we informed you about the progress of the game development and listened to your suggestions, and it is no different after the game's release.

⚓ After analyzing your feedback about the game being too short, having too much money, and progressing through the game too fast we decided to prepare a game-changing balance update for you. Also, we don’t want to make the game too hard for those who are enjoying the current game balance so we decided to create game difficulties: Normal and Easy. The current balance will be easy mode and new changes normal mode.

⚓ We decreased most of the material prices. instead, we increased tools and ship costs and changed hammer damage. Moreover, we improved the process of materials gathering thanks to the burner. We also decided to raise the effectiveness of workers you can hire. Now they will provide more materials. We are aware that orders were the biggest problem, therefore we decreased the amount of experience and gold they give.

⚓ Moreover, we prepared a new game mechanic for you - the destruction progress bar. Now you can see the percentage of damage on the currently booked ship so you can see how much there is left to destroy.

⚓ The most important suggestion and comment that appeared most often is the possibility of complete ship disassembly, we are analyzing such options, but since we designed the game for limited disassembly, it would require a complete redesign of ship models and implementation of new mechanics. Nevertheless, we are analyzing this possibility, but first of all, we are focusing on improving the current version of the game.

⚓ Finally, we prepared new achievements connected with destroying every ship in the game.

Please write to us what you think about the upcoming changes and we encourage you to join our Discord channel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286880/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator/

What would the Ship Graveyard be without the ships? They can be a huge source of materials, but of course, they are not endless themselves. What to do when you take them apart fully and you still need more and more materials? Today we will present something, that we are very proud of - the ordering ships feature. 🛒

In earlier devlogs, we mentioned that in your cosy, little house you will find a computer which can be used for some cool features. Today is the day! We can finally present it! Hurray!  

After turning on the computer, the first thing that will pop up is ShipTube. It's a website where you can order as many ships as you need! The first thing you will see on the left of the screen, are active orders. If you ordered something recently, you will find it there. On the right side of the screen, you can see your balance (all the money you've earned) and available ships. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/5897fb275eb8fad66fa7c2520aaf54ae3487f247.png

By studing this part carefully you can decide if this certain ship is all you need, or maybe you would like to choose a different one. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/e48ffc7046b818544f9066e491cc35f0e769da25.png
